test_get_valid_token: test the gws_bridge get_valid_token function returns a non-expired OAuth access token
test_refresh_expired_token: test the gws_bridge refresh_token function refreshes an expired OAuth token via the token_uri endpoint
test_bridge_main_injects_token: test the gws_bridge main function injects GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN into the subprocess environment
test_calendar_list_uses_events_list: test the google_api calendar_list function calls gws with events list and date range parameters
test_get_credentials_refresh_persists: test the google_api get_credentials function refreshes expired credentials and persists authorized_user type
